name: solarabase_get_document_pages
description: Fetch the indexed pages of a single document from the Solarabase knowledge base, including each page's full text and the document's root index (summary, key themes, entity index). Use this to read a specific document in depth after finding its id via solarabase_list_documents or solarabase_retrieve.

document_id.description: The UUID of the document to fetch pages for
